blocks.heading: How We Select Accountants
blocks.text: OUR STANDARDSHow We Select AccountantsWe take a considered approach to selecting accountants for the Your Accountant Match network. Our checks are designed to confirm who they are, understand the services they provide and help ensure each accountant is appropriately matched to their local area. Here is what our selection and ongoing review process includes.1Identity and Business Details ConfirmedBefore an accountant joins our network, we confirm their identity and key business details. This may include checking their legal or trading name, ABN, business location and contact information against appropriate public records. These checks help us establish that we are dealing with a genuine Australian accounting business and that the information supplied to us is consistent and current at the time of onboarding.2Professional Registrations Checked Where RelevantWe check relevant professional registrations according to the services the accountant intends to provide. This may include confirming registration as a tax agent or BAS agent through the Tax Practitioners Board and reviewing other professional credentials where applicable. Because different accounting services require different qualifications and registrations, our checks are tailored to the work each accountant represents they are authorised and equipped to undertake.3Services and Areas of Expertise EstablishedNot every accountant provides the same services or works with the same types of clients. We establish the accountant’s principal areas of service, which may include personal taxation, business accounting, bookkeeping, BAS and GST, payroll, self-managed super funds or business registrations. This information helps us understand the type of assistance they offer and supports a more relevant introduction based on the customer’s selected accounting needs.4Service Area ConfirmedWe confirm the geographical area each accountant intends to service, including the suburbs, postcodes or broader region covered by their Your Accountant Match territory. Depending on the accountant and the customer’s preference, services may be provided in person, remotely or through a combination of both. Confirming the service area helps us connect customers with an accountant who is available to assist people and businesses in their area.5Professional Indemnity Insurance Checked Where ApplicableWhere professional indemnity insurance is applicable to the accountant’s services or registration, we request confirmation of appropriate cover. Professional indemnity insurance can provide protection in connection with claims arising from professional services. Requirements may vary according to the accountant’s registrations, professional memberships and the services they provide. Accountants remain responsible for maintaining any insurance required for their business and professional activities.6Periodic Information ReviewsOur checking process does not necessarily end when an accountant joins the network. We may periodically ask participating accountants to confirm or update important information, including their contact details, services, registrations, insurance and service area. We may also review publicly available professional information where appropriate. These reviews help us keep our network records current and identify material changes that could affect an accountant’s participation or the services they provide.7A Clear Process for Customer ConcernsIf a customer raises a concern about an introduction or their experience with a participating accountant, we provide a clear way for them to contact Your Accountant Match. We record and consider the information provided, seek further details where appropriate and determine whether any action is required concerning the accountant’s participation in our network. Professional service complaints may also need to be directed to the accountant or an appropriate regulatory body.Our Commitment to Better-Matched IntroductionsOur selection process is designed to support informed, relevant introductions—not to guarantee a particular result or replace a customer’s own decision-making. Customers are encouraged to discuss their requirements, fees and engagement terms directly with their matched accountant before proceeding. Your Accountant Match introduces one participating accountant based on the customer’s area and requested services, without distributing their details to multiple providers.Find My Accountant

blocks.heading: What is Your Accountant Match?
blocks.text: A BETTER WAY TO FIND YOUR ACCOUNTANTWhat is Your Accountant Match?Your Accountant Match is a free matching service that connects Australians with accountants from our network, matched to your area and the accounting help you need.Our founder created Your Accountant Match because he saw a better way to introduce people to a local accountant than leaving them to choose from a directory listing. He brings more than 19 years of experience working closely with members of the National Tax & Accountants’ Association (NTAA) and accounting professionals across Australia.Whether you need a tax accountant, registered tax agent, bookkeeper, CPA or SMSF specialist, simply tell us what you need. We’ll find your match.
